Header: Erysiphe polygoni Vernacular Name: Mel sambal Noi.

Prevention: Use seeds from disease free source
Seed treatment for one hour with
Destroy the collateral hosts of the soybean, lentil, clover, wild bean near bunds
Monitoring: Observe weekly for white patches on the upper surface of the leaves and other green parts from 35 to 40 days of sowing.
If the relative humidity increase more than 90% monitor for white patches on upper surface every alternative day from 30 days of sowing.
Observe for premature defoliation of plants at pod setting stage.
Monitor the distorted and shrivelled pods for severe infection.
Direct Control: Remove and destroy the infected plants.
Kernel extract 50ml/ litre of water or
Oil 30ml/litre twice at ten days interval from initial disease appearance. or
Leaf extract 10% at the initiation of disease and repeat after ten days.
After harvest debris should be collected and buried for composting with
Restrictions: Flusilazole 40% EC@ 200ml / acre in 200 litre of water twice at initiation of disease and ten days later.
Carbendazim @ 200g/acre in 200 litre of water at initiation of disease and repeat after ten days.
U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use)
